mfa.heading: Two-step verification
mfa.setupHint: Admin accounts need two-step verification. You only set it up once; after that you enter the code from the app on each sign-in.

totp.label: Verification code
totp.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.hint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved during setup. Each works once.

errors.codeInvalid: The code format is not valid.

setup.stepApp: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) on your phone and add a new account.
setup.stepScan: In the app choose “scan a QR code” and scan this code.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.stepSecret: If you cannot scan it, choose “enter a setup key” and type this code:
setup.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.

mfa.recoveryCodesHint: If you lose your phone you can sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Save them somewhere safe now; they will not be shown again.

request.heading: Reset your password
request.hint: Enter your e-mail and the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. We will e-mail you a code.

code.heading: Check your e-mail
code.hint: If your details are right we e-mailed you a 6-digit code. It is valid for 15 minutes; if it does not arrive, start over.
code.label: Code from the e-mail

password.heading: Choose a new password
password.hint: At least 12 characters, and different from your old password.
password.label: New password

done.heading: Your password is updated
done.hint: You can sign in with your new password. Your open sessions were closed for safety.

errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.

problems.invalidRequest: The e-mail or the verification code is wrong.
problems.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
problems.invalidInput: Check your details and try again.
problems.weakPassword: The password breaks the rules or is the same as the old one.
problems.expired: The request has expired. Start over.
problems.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
problems.unavailable: This is not possible right now. Try again shortly.

home.heading: You are signed in
home.absoluteExpiresAt: Session ends at the latest at
home.next: Role-based panels (admin, waiter, kitchen) will be added in the next steps. For now you can see here that your session works.

problems.unavailable: Your session cannot be loaded right now. Try again shortly.
